law: Exact right-colour-Gauss FrameGauss source; field-coordinate left Noether spin; cubic tight-binding extension with same-source Peierls field legs and finite Gaussian longitudinal Gauss energy.
units: hbar=1; q=-1; energy in the local model's inverse-inertia units; length units use r=1.1 and Gaussian width=.35; no c or mass conversion.

modules.model_dependency: rich_frame_gauss_20261014_model.py (imported for pure constructor functions only)

functionality.source: Exact Gauss-projected dressed source from the same frame constructor, both N=0 to N=1 channels, physical left differential S and the two-channel N=1 to N=2 CAR map.
functionality.mobile_state: Single charged source on eight open cubic sites; each site carries all l=1 M/K rotor states, N=1 physical frame doublet and all four vector oscillator states at total occupation cutoff one.
functionality.observables: Same-H strict opposite-corner probability, site distribution, all Cartesian currents, vector-field energy and physical source-frame S_z; no outgoing global source postselection.
functionality.controls: Identical-seed no-pulse evolution; all Cartesian hopping/current links removed; field-coordinate Peierls dependence removed while bare hopping remains.
functionality.adjacent_charge: Same-source neutral-to-charged G(z) at .9+.07i plus exact N=1 to N=2 source-sector energies and two-channel CAR closure.

compatibility: This is a fresh finite law assembled from the FrameGauss pure constructor; no wave5 collision states, old producer CLI, photon D, source labels, or archived event data are imported. It is not yet the requested two-species common-H interaction.
